big_case.notes: Pro se application to stay a Maryland writ of possession at the end of a long-running residential foreclosure (Prince George's County CAEF17-36003); the state appeal was dismissed and the Supreme Court of Maryland denied review. Stakes are confined to the parties; no federal question of reach beyond them, and the Chief Justice denied it in chambers without a response.
